transcript: Speaker A: 18 साल में शादी, 23 साल में बेवा, बीच में पांच बेटियां। कोई पढ़ाई नहीं, कोई जॉब नहीं, इंग्लिश का एक वर्ड नहीं आता। अब्बू ने कहा बेटा हम बूढ़े हैं, तुम्हें और पांच बच्चों को कैसे पालेंगे? मायके का दरवाजा बंद हो गया। एक ऐप ने जिंदगी का दरवाजा खोल दिया। मेरा नाम ज़ारा है, लखनऊ से। 18 में शादी, 23 में बेवा, पांच बेटियां। कोई पढ़ाई नहीं, कोई स्किल नहीं, इंग्लिश का ई भी नहीं आता था। बैंक में दो लाख थे, महीने का खर्चा 18,000। 11 महीने, फिर कुछ नहीं। ससुराल ने बोला हमसे नहीं होगा। मायके गई, अब्बू ने हाथ जोड़ लिए। बोले जगह नहीं है, पांच बच्चों को कैसे रखेंगे? मैं टूट गई, पर पांच बेटियां सो रही थीं उस कमरे में। इनके लिए टूटना अलाउड नहीं था। नौकरी ढूंढी, कॉल सेंटर में ओपनिंग थी 12,000 की। गई, मैनेजर ने इंग्लिश में बात की। मैं चुप, एक वर्ड नहीं निकला। मैनेजर ने बोला, 'मैम, वी नीड समवन हू कैन स्पीक बेसिक इंग्लिश।' वापस आ गई। फिर स्कूल गई, बेटियों का एडमिशन। फॉर्म इंग्लिश में था, टीचर इंग्लिश में बात कर रही थी। मैंने बोला दीदी हिंदी में समझा दो। टीचर ने अजीब सा मुंह बनाया। बेटी ने देखा, कुछ नहीं बोली। पर उस दिन समझ आई, अगर मैं इंग्लिश नहीं सीखूंगी तो मेरे बच्चे भी पीछे रहेंगे। एक रात फोन पे इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप का ऐड दिखा। ₹1 का ट्रायल। सोचा ₹1 में क्या जाएगा? डाउनलोड किया। स्पोकन इंग्लिश शो देखा। एक्सपर्ट ने हिंदी में समझा के इंग्लिश बोलना सिखाया, बेसिक से। हेलो, थैंक यू, एक्सक्यूज मी। फिर, 'आई नीड टू चेक माय बैंक बैलेंस।' 'माय डॉटर... [At 18 married, at 23 widowed, with five daughters. No education, no job, didn't know a word of English. Father said we are old, how will we support you and five kids? The door to my parents' home closed. But one app opened the door to life. My name is Zara, from Lucknow. Married at 18, widowed at 23, five daughters. No education, no skills, didn't even know the 'E' of English. Had 2 lakhs in the bank, monthly expenses of 18,000. 11 months, then nothing. In-laws said we can't do this. Went to parents, father folded his hands. Said there's no space, how will we keep five kids? I broke down, but my five daughters were sleeping in that room. Breaking down was not allowed for them. Looked for a job, there was a call center opening for 12,000. Went, the manager spoke in English. I was silent, not a word came out. The manager said, 'Ma'am, we need someone who can speak basic English.' Came back. Then went to school for daughters' admission. The form was in English, the teacher was speaking in English. I said sister, explain in Hindi. The teacher made a weird face. My daughter saw, said nothing. But that day I understood, if I don't learn English, my kids will also lag behind. One night saw an ad for English Seekho app on my phone. 1 rupee trial. Thought what's there to lose in 1 rupee? Downloaded it. Watched the spoken English show. The expert explained in Hindi and taught how to speak English, from basics. Hello, thank you, excuse me. Then, 'I need to check my bank balance.' 'My daughter needs admission in class one.' 'Can you explain this form to me?' Learned the exact English I needed in life. Bank English, school English, job English. At night, after putting my five daughters to sleep, I practiced with the AI coach. The house would be silent, and I would speak English with the AI coach on my phone. 'Good morning sir, I am calling about the job opening.' 'My name is Zara.' 'I have five years of experience in household management.' Learned from the AI coach. If I spoke wrong, it corrected me. Corrected me 100 times, never said you can't do it. It wasn't like my in-laws, it wasn't like my father. In two months, I could speak basic English. Went back to the same call center, same manager. This time I said, 'Good morning sir, I had applied earlier. I have been working on my English. I would like another chance.' The manager looked, said, 'Your English has improved. Welcome aboard.' Got the 12,000 job. Then saw the business section on Seekho. Learned reselling from Meesho. Learned to make a WhatsApp channel for part-time income. Worked at night after putting kids to sleep. Job plus part-time, both. Today it's been three years. Promoted at my job, 22,000. 12,000 more from part-time. Total 34,000 a month. English gave me a job, job gave money, money gave respect. Five daughters are in school, all are studying. Teachers now speak in English, I reply in English. My daughter watches and smiles. Father came last year, said daughter, it was a mistake. You were so young, we got scared. I said father, now I don't want anyone's support. I am my daughters' support myself. Download English Seekho app, watch expert videos, practice with AI coach. 1 rupee trial. 15 minutes daily, after putting kids to sleep, in your room, alone. If you've become a mother, become a lioness, and a lioness must know English, otherwise no one listens even in the jungle.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A young widowed mother of five daughters shares her emotional journey of overcoming financial hardship and social rejection by learning English. After being turned down at a call center and facing embarrassment at her children's school, she uses the English Seekho app's 1-rupee trial to practice daily with its AI coach. She successfully secures a job, starts a side business, and encourages other mothers to download the app to become self-reliant.
